newsitem.title: USA: Richardson extends offer expiration date.
newsitem.headline: Richardson extends offer expiration date.

text.p: Richardson Electronics Ltd said Tuesday it was extending to February 14 the expiration date of its offer to holders of its 7-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due December 15, 2006 to exhcange old debentures for a new issue previously announced December 18.
The new issue is of 8-1/4 percent convertible senior subordinated debentures due June 15, 2006.
The exchange offer was to have expired at the end of January 31.

Richardson, a manufacturer of electron tubes and power semiconductors, said the date was extended to allow for regulatory approval of its recently filed Form T-3 application for qualification of the indenture under which the new debentures will be issued.
